source: A. B. Davidson, An Introductory Hebrew Grammar (22nd ed., 1923, public domain)

units.title: The Aleph-Bet
units.description: Learn the 22 consonants, their names, final forms, and right-to-left reading.

units.title: Gutturals and Consonant Sounds
units.description: Recognize the guttural letters and use a consistent transliteration.

units.title: Matres Lectionis
units.description: Learn how certain consonant letters also mark long vowels.

units.title: Masoretic Pointing and Vowel Signs
units.description: Read the diacritic system that records vowels and pronunciation.

units.title: Vowel Quality and Length
units.description: Compare long and short vowels and read qamets correctly.

units.title: Vowel Letters and Vowel Points Together
units.description: Read words whose vowel is written both by a letter and by a point.

units.title: Syllables and Shewa
units.description: Divide words into syllables and distinguish vocal from silent shewa.

units.title: Dagesh
units.description: Distinguish dagesh lene from dagesh forte.

units.title: The Quiescent Letters
units.description: Recognize when א, ה, ו, and י fall silent.

units.title: Accents and Pause
units.description: Read the accents as stress, punctuation, and chant, and recognize pausal forms.

units.title: Metheg and Maqqeph
units.description: Recognize the secondary accent and the hyphen that binds words.

units.title: Qere and Kethib
units.description: Tell what is written from what is read.

units.title: Roots and Patterns
units.description: Use consonantal roots and patterns to analyze vocabulary.

units.title: Gender and Number
units.description: Recognize noun and adjective gender, number, and agreement.

units.title: Independent Pronouns
units.description: Read the personal pronouns by person, gender, and number.

units.title: The Definite Article
units.description: Mark a noun as definite with the article.

units.title: Adjectives and the Verbless Sentence
units.description: Make adjectives agree, and read two-part sentences without a verb.

units.title: The Construct State and the Directional Ending
units.description: Join nouns as "X of Y", and mark motion toward a place.

units.title: Prefix Prepositions
units.description: Recognize the prepositions that attach to the next word.

units.title: Independent Prepositions
units.description: Read prepositions that stand as separate words.

units.title: The Conjunction Waw
units.description: Join words and clauses with waw and read its changing vowel.

units.title: Suffixes on Nouns
units.description: Read possessive suffixes on nouns.

units.title: Suffixes on Prepositions
units.description: Read pronoun objects attached to prepositions.

units.title: Demonstratives
units.description: Point to things near and far with this, that, these, and those.

units.title: Who, What, and the Relative אֲשֶׁר
units.description: Ask who and what, and join a clause to a noun with אֲשֶׁר.

units.title: The Object Marker
units.description: Find the definite direct object marked by אֵת.

units.title: Strong Nouns (First Declension)
units.description: Inflect nouns like דָּבָר whose vowels reduce under endings.

units.title: Segholate Nouns (Second Declension)
units.description: Inflect nouns like מֶלֶךְ and סֵפֶר.

units.title: Adjective Comparison
units.description: Form comparatives and superlatives with מִן, the article, and repetition.

units.title: Numbers One to Ten
units.description: Count from one to ten with the right gender.

units.title: Higher Numbers and Ordinals
units.description: Count above ten and use the ordinals.

units.title: Questions and Negation
units.description: Turn a statement into a question, and deny it.

units.title: Conjunctions
units.description: Join clauses with or, if, that, so that, and lest.

units.title: Adverbs and Interjections
units.description: Read adverbs, interjections, and oath formulas.

units.title: Qal Qatal
units.description: Learn the Qal perfect and its person endings.

units.title: The Qal Participle
units.description: Read the active participle as verb, adjective, and noun.

units.title: Participial Nouns (Third Declension)
units.description: Inflect nouns built like the participle, such as כֹּהֵן.

units.title: Qal Yiqtol and Tenseless Forms
units.description: Recognize the Qal prefix conjugation and related forms.

units.title: Wayyiqtol
units.description: Read the waw-consecutive imperfect in narrative sequences.

units.title: Weqatal
units.description: Read the waw-consecutive perfect in continuing sequences.

units.title: The Imperative
units.description: Command the person addressed.

units.title: Jussive and Cohortative
units.description: Express wishes for the first, second, and third person.

units.title: The Infinitives
units.description: Use the infinitive construct and the infinitive absolute.

units.title: Transitive and Stative Verbs
units.description: Distinguish active, intransitive, and stative Qal verbs and their forms.

units.title: The Verb Stems: An Overview
units.description: See the scheme of the derived stems and how they are named.

units.title: Niphal
units.description: Learn the Niphal stem, the simple reflexive and passive.

units.title: Piel
units.description: Learn the Piel stem and its intensive and factitive meanings.

units.title: Pual
units.description: Learn the Pual stem, the passive of Piel, and contrast it with the Qal passive.

units.title: Hiphil
units.description: Learn the Hiphil stem and its causative meanings.

units.title: Hophal
units.description: Learn the Hophal stem, the passive of Hiphil.

units.title: Hitpael
units.description: Learn the Hitpael stem and its reflexive meanings.

units.title: Object Suffixes on the Verb
units.description: Recognize pronoun objects attached to verbs.

units.title: Weak Verbs: Names and Classes
units.description: Name a weak verb by the position of its weak letter.

units.title: Pe-Nun Verbs
units.description: Track the weak first radical nun and its changes.

units.title: Pe-Guttural Verbs
units.description: Handle a guttural in first position.

units.title: Pe-Aleph Verbs
units.description: Learn the first-radical aleph that quiesces in the imperfect.

units.title: Ayin-Guttural Verbs
units.description: Handle a guttural in middle position.

units.title: Lamed-Guttural Verbs
units.description: Handle a guttural in final position.

units.title: Lamed-Aleph Verbs
units.description: Learn the final-radical aleph and its quiescence.

units.title: Pe-Yod and Pe-Waw Verbs
units.description: Track the weak first radical yod and waw.

units.title: Hollow Verbs (Ayin-Waw and Ayin-Yod)
units.description: Recognize weak middle radicals and their vowel changes.

units.title: Nouns from Hollow Roots
units.description: Read nouns built on Ayin-Waw and Ayin-Yod roots.

units.title: Double-Ayin (Geminate) Verbs
units.description: Recognize doubled (geminate) verbs.

units.title: Nouns from Double-Ayin Roots
units.description: Read nouns built on geminate (double-Ayin) roots.

units.title: Lamed-He Verbs
units.description: Recognize the weak final radical he.

units.title: Nouns from Lamed-He Roots
units.description: Read nouns built on Lamed-He roots and common irregular nouns.

units.title: Apocopated Forms
units.description: Recognize the shortened jussive and wayyiqtol of Lamed-He verbs.

units.title: Doubly Weak and Defective Verbs
units.description: Handle verbs with two weak letters and verbs that borrow forms.

units.title: Complete Parsing
units.description: Parse verbs fully by root, stem, conjugation, and person.

units.title: Form Production
units.description: Produce verb forms from root, stem, and features.

units.title: Verb Review and Reading
units.description: Consolidate the verb system in short phrases.

units.title: Noun Clauses and Verbless Sentences
units.description: Recognize sentences that have no finite verb.

units.title: Construct Chains and Genitive Relations
units.description: Read the construct state and its genitive relations.

units.title: Agreement and Pronominal Reference
units.description: Check subject-predicate and pronominal agreement.

units.title: Waw and Circumstantial Clauses
units.description: Tell narrative waw from the waw that describes circumstances.

units.title: Relative Clauses
units.description: Read clauses introduced by אֲשֶׁר and כִּי.

units.title: Conditional Clauses
units.description: Read conditions with אִם, כִּי, לוּ, and לוּלֵא.

units.title: Purpose Clauses
units.description: State purpose with לְמַעַן, פֶּן, and the infinitive.

units.title: Reading, Review, and Final Checkpoint
units.description: Read a short passage and consolidate the whole course.
